'''March 2001 Smyrna tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Smyrna, Georgia on 3 March 2001. [[Andrew Vernon]] won it. It is known from James McNash's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1834">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-smryna-georgia-3-3-01d1834/ smryna-georgia-3-3-01], DeckTech (James "kmcnash" McNash, 5 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-smryna-georgia-3-3-01d1834/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Smyrna, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Andrew Vernon]]
